features.geometry_status: FAA NASR runway-end controls; ALDOT airport-pavement inventory polygons for runways, taxiways and aprons; derived route graph; approximate stands, service points and operational semantics.
features.runway_intersection_classification: DERIVED from authoritative FAA NASR runway-end coordinates

features.surface_area_source_classification: SOURCE_BACKED_DERIVED (ALDOT GIS pavement inventory; not survey-grade taxiway centerlines)

limitations: Graph nodes and centerline edges remain simulation routing abstractions; ALDOT inventory polygons do not define taxiway centerlines or legal routing.
route_graph.source: FAA airport diagram topology, aligned by review to ALDOT pavement surfaces

limitations: Centerline, heading, and intersection are calculations from endpoint records.
runway_centerlines_and_intersection.source: Derived from FAA NASR surveyed runway-end coordinates

limitations: FAA source survey date is 2006-05-22; published decimal precision is not an accuracy guarantee.
runway_reference_points.source: FAA NASR 28-day subscription, APT_RWY_END.csv; Goal 26 anchors

runway_taxiway_apron_pavement_areas.dataset_date: ALDOT program says 2018 study; pavement condition records include 2019 survey dates; hosted layer last edited 2024-10-17
limitations: Pavement inventory sections are not an FAA-certified movement-area survey or taxiway centerline dataset.
Some broad taxiway/taxilane and unclassified OTHER polygons describe pavement inventory extents and must not be interpreted as an aircraft centerline.
The 2D source has no vertical coordinates; elevations are unknown.
The layer is a 2018 study with later hosted edits; it is not guaranteed to describe current pavement condition or operational status.
No gate/stand positions or GSE staging positions are surveyed by this source.
runway_taxiway_apron_pavement_areas.source: Alabama Department of Transportation Aeronautics Bureau, Airport Pavement Management Program GIS
runway_taxiway_apron_pavement_areas.transformation: WGS 84 geographic coordinates to airport-local ENU meters using the existing Goal 26 KAUO ARP origin and WGS-84 ECEF/topocentric conversion

limitations: GSE depots, service points, fleet inventory, and access routes are simulation assumptions.
service_areas.source: Illustrative Goal 41 ground-unit staging and service-point mapping

limitations: Gate IDs, stand locations, and stand service approaches are scenario assumptions.
stands_and_gates.source: Illustrative simulator mapping; no surveyed stand coordinates obtained

graph_alignment_audit.interpretation: diagnostic overlap only; pavement extents do not establish legal centerline routing
graph_alignment_audit.method: 101 evenly spaced points per straight graph edge tested against ALDOT taxiway/apron outer rings
